sources.summary: The Latin American Architecture Biennial (BAL) is a forum that, every two years since 2009, has brought together the most notable examples of young Latin American architecture in Spain. It is organized by the Association for Strategic Reflection on Architecture (AREA). BAL serves as a key venue for the recognition of young architects from the region, and we are aiming to reach as many Mexican architects under the age of 40 as possible who are interested in participating.
